question: Conditioning polarity difference: depol_test spike_count minus hyperpol_test spike_count. This probes the net asymmetry between depolarizing and hyperpolarizing conditioning. H3 (null) predicts the largest gap (~25) because no slow mechanism counters the depol enhancement; H1 (slow K) predicts intermediate (~23) because slow K partially counters; H2 (slow Na) predicts smallest (~21) because slow Na inactivation reduces spiking in both. H2 and H3 bands are mutually exclusive, ensuring this probe can kill at least one. Severity: if no slow process exists (H3), the difference should be largest because nothing counteracts depol-induced facilitation.
